# Security

- SEC-015: Cryptography and deserialization follow Microsoft's guidance: don't write your own; protect data with ASP.NET Core Data Protection, or encrypt with an authenticated cipher (AesGcm or ChaCha20Poly1305); compare secrets with CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals; derive keys from passwords with PBKDF2 over SHA-256 or better and a high iteration count; draw secrets from RandomNumberGenerator; and treat everything deserialized from outside the app as untrusted input.
